name: context-handoff
description: Past a context threshold, records a hand-off and continues the work from the notes: in a new desktop-app session by default, or in this one after a compaction or the app's clear

enabled.title: Automatic hand-off
enabled.description: Hand off on its own once the context window passes the threshold. Off, /handoff-now still works.

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: How full the context window is, in percent, before the hand-off starts. Checked after each turn.

retriggerStep.title: Retry step (%)
retriggerStep.description: After an interrupted or failed hand-off, try again once the context has grown this many points.

reset.title: How the context is reset
reset.description: session: the hand-off turn opens a new desktop-app session that continues from the notes (moved to top level); this one stays as it is. Where no session can be opened, the conversation is compacted instead. compact: compact the conversation down to the notes in place; the process, model and settings stay. clear: the desktop app clears the conversation (a fresh row, the old one under Resume previous session); the app starts a new process only at your next message, and the resume runs after that message.

oldSession.title: The old session after a hand-off to a new one
oldSession.description: unpin: the session that handed off is unpinned, so the new one takes its place at the top. keep: it is left as it is.

compaction.title: How the compaction is made
compaction.description: auto: the engine's compaction call, or the /compact command where the session has no such call (the desktop app's). call: the call alone. command: /compact alone, queued as if typed.

closeCommand.title: Project close skill
closeCommand.description: A slash command or skill of the project that records the hand-off, run when the project has it. Otherwise a built-in prompt records PROGRESS.md or HANDOFF.md.

closePrompt.title: Hand-off prompt
closePrompt.description: Replaces the built-in hand-off prompt and the close skill. {percent} and {threshold} are filled in.

resumePrompt.title: Resume prompt
resumePrompt.description: Replaces the built-in prompt submitted after the reset.

pauseRemoteControl.title: Pause Remote Control for the clear
pauseRemoteControl.description: A session serving Remote Control cannot be cleared. On, the mod turns Remote Control off for the clear and on again once the fresh conversation has run its first turn.
